# Zan Media Group

> Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads agency for local home-service contractors, based in Wilmington, NC. We run lead ads, then an automated system texts, qualifies and books each new lead within 60 seconds.

## What we do
- Meta ad campaign build and management: strategy, ad creative and copy, targeting, ongoing optimization
- Lead capture system and conversion tracking
- 60-second speed-to-lead text follow-up
- Automated appointment setting on the contractor's calendar
- Weekly performance reports
- Organic social content: monthly content plans and video scripts, and on the Partner plan filming, editing and posting
- Website build, hosting and care, Google Business Profile posts and local SEO

## Who we work with
Home-service contractors: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, painting, remodeling, cleaning and pressure washing.

## Where
Based in Wilmington, NC 28409. Serving home-service contractors in New Hanover, Brunswick, Pender and Onslow counties: Wilmington, Castle Hayne, Ogden, Wrightsville Beach, Leland, Southport, Oak Island, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach, Hampstead, Surf City, Burgaw and Jacksonville, NC.

## Plans
Ad spend is always separate, paid by the client directly to Meta.
- Starter: $1,500/month. Campaign build and management, ad creative and copy, lead capture system, weekly performance report, and a one-time setup of the Facebook, Instagram and Google Business profiles.
- Growth: $1,000/month plus $75 per booked appointment. Everything in Starter, plus 60-second speed-to-lead follow-up, automated appointment setting, a monthly content plan with 4 video scripts, website hosting and care, a weekly Google Business Profile post and monthly review requests.
- Partner: $2,500/month. Everything in Growth, plus market exclusivity, priority optimization, a monthly strategy call, done-for-you social content (8 videos a month, filmed, edited and posted), a full website build or rebuild, and local SEO with service and town pages, directory listings and a monthly ranking report.
- Website build: included on Partner, a one-time add-on on Growth. The client owns their domain and website.
- Setup: $500 one time on every plan.
- Terms: 90-day initial term, then month-to-month with 30 days notice.
- Guarantee: we keep working for free until the client gets their first 5 qualified leads.
